svg.title: Wide expert parallelism
svg.text: MoE: data-parallel attention + expert parallelism across 32 GPUs
LEADERWORKERSET GROUP: 4 NODES × 8 GPUS, ONE FABRIC BLOCK
each rank has its own requests and KV cache
each GPU holds 8 of 256 experts; all-to-all
Before: TP=8 × 4 nodes split every expert across 32 GPUs: expert layers spent most of their time in all-reduce.
